b1-07-01.title: Communicative Challenge: After Primary School
b1-07-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg what students can do after primary school in Hungary. You (Meg) say that they can apply to a grammar school and that they take the school-leaving exam at the end of it.
b1-07-01.prompt: Tell Petra what students can do after primary school and which exam they take at the grammar school.
cues: Say what students can do after primary school
Say which exam they take at the grammar school
b1-07-01.target: Az általános iskola után a diákok gimnáziumba jelentkezhetnek. A gimnáziumban érettségi vizsgát tesznek.
b1-07-01.english: After primary school, students can apply to a grammar school. At the grammar school they take the school-leaving exam.
b1-07-01.canDo: I can explain the main stages of the Hungarian education system.

b1-07-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Why This Course
b1-07-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg why she goes to the evening Hungarian course. You (Meg) say that you go so that you can speak Hungarian better at the office.
b1-07-02.prompt: Tell Károly why you attend the course.
cues: Say that you attend the course for a reason
Say what you want to do better at the office
b1-07-02.target: Azért járok erre a tanfolyamra, hogy jobban beszéljek magyarul az irodában.
b1-07-02.english: I attend this course so that I can speak Hungarian better at the office.
b1-07-02.canDo: I can express purpose and goals using azért, hogy + subjunctive.

b1-07-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Remembering Words
b1-07-03.scenario: Anna tells Meg that she cannot remember the new Hungarian words and that her exam is soon. You (Meg) advise her to concentrate on the exam and to repeat the words every day.
b1-07-03.prompt: Advise Anna what to concentrate on and what to do with the words every day.
cues: Tell Anna what to concentrate on
Tell her what to do with the words every day
b1-07-03.target: Összpontosíts a vizsgára, és ismételd a szavakat minden nap!
b1-07-03.english: Concentrate on the exam and repeat the words every day!
b1-07-03.canDo: I can discuss effective study techniques, focus, and memory.

b1-07-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Oral Exam
b1-07-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg how her Hungarian oral exam went. You (Meg) say that it went very well, that you got a good grade and that you passed.
b1-07-04.prompt: Tell Petra that the oral exam went well, what grade you got and that you passed.
cues: Say that the exam went very well
Say what kind of grade you got
Say that you passed the oral exam
b1-07-04.target: Nagyon jól sikerült! Jó érdemjegyet kaptam, és átmentem a szóbeli vizsgán.
b1-07-04.english: It went very well! I got a good grade, and I passed the oral exam.
b1-07-04.canDo: I can describe exam preparation, taking an exam, and results.

b1-07-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Learning at Any Age
b1-07-05.scenario: Anna asks Meg whether adults can still learn new things. You (Meg) say that people can learn all their lives and that self-study is a good opportunity.
b1-07-05.prompt: Tell Anna that people can learn all their lives and that self-study is a good opportunity.
cues: Say how long people can learn
Say what kind of opportunity self-study is
b1-07-05.target: Az ember élete végéig tanulhat. Az önképzés jó lehetőség.
b1-07-05.english: People can learn all their lives. Self-study is a good opportunity.
b1-07-05.canDo: I can discuss lifelong learning, retraining, and personal development.

b1-07-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: End of Grammar School
b1-07-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg what happens at the end of grammar school in Hungary. You (Meg) say that the students take the school-leaving exam and can then apply to university.
b1-07-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what the students do at the end of grammar school and what they can do after the exam.
cues: Say which exam the students take at the end of grammar school
Say where they can apply after the exam
b1-07-consolidation.target: A gimnázium végén a diákok érettségi vizsgát tesznek. Az érettségi után egyetemre jelentkezhetnek.
b1-07-consolidation.english: At the end of grammar school, the students take the school-leaving exam. After it they can apply to university.
b1-07-consolidation.canDo: I can describe the Hungarian education system and school stages accurately.
